interview.secured: Day secured means you've completed your daily goal (7,000 steps) and locked in your progress for that day.
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is.
interview.selfReported: Self-reported means you manually logged or confirmed the 7,000 steps yourself rather than it being automatically tracked.
interview.tomorrow: 9 - I like watching the number move and the streak counter is satisfying; I want to keep my streak going.

goals.text: Open the challenge the app shows you, join it, open today's task and finish it with the button that starts with Done. When the app asks, choose Keep it private.
